prompts.cart:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent production world prop sprite for the hand-drawn cartoon fantasy game 深渊行者. Reference is the approved camp-unified-v2 direction. Rounded readable structure, soft dark navy-brown contours, broad hand-painted color planes, 2-3 value shading and sparse material lines. Orthographic isometric view with ground axis slopes +/-18/32, soft light upper-left. Actual transparent alpha background, no text, labels, UI, checkerboard, surrounding scenery, water, grass, decorative pedestal, or cast ground shadow. Single complete object centered with safety margin. Readable at 80-150px width.
Subject: one small broken caravan cart, a stout wooden wagon box with broad warm-brown boards, two clearly visible chunky wooden wheels with thick rims, a broken axle and one short snapped towing shaft. A compact torn navy cloth draped over the rear edge and a single little travel bag within the cart. Damage visible as one broken board and axle, not a pile of fragments. Maintain a complete recognizable cart silhouette, not thin outline wireframe. No person or horse.
